mails.outlet: Ontario Urban Forest Council, Heritage Tree Program
mails.subject: Licence for the Ontario Heritage Tree map data
mails.body:
Hello,

My name is Hidde and I am building ancienttrees.app, a platform for remarkable
trees. My goal is to get people excited about old trees and to encourage them to
go outside and look at them.

I would like to show Ontario's Heritage Trees on the map, credited to the
Heritage Tree Program with a link back, starting around Toronto. The map data
carries no licence that I can find, so I am asking rather than assuming, and if
this is Forests Canada's call rather than yours I would be glad to be pointed
their way.

The site is free and has no ads, but I am building an app with a paid tier
later, so I will not claim non-commercial. We would leave out every tree your
own data marks as private.

Would you be willing to licence it, or tell me the terms you would want?

And either way: which Ontario tree do you think more people should go and see?

Kind regards,
Hidde
ancienttrees.app
